name: Commands Anomalous Assets
description: You have the authority and knowledge to deploy and control a variety of anomalous assets for Foundation operations.
connectionOptions: One PC was extracted from a dangerous situation by an anomalous asset you deployed.
You're considering recruiting one PC for anomalous operations training.
One PC has witnessed the aftermath of one of your anomalous operations gone wrong.
You're investigating a potential leak of anomalous tech, and one PC is a person of interest.

abilities.name: Asset Deployment
abilities.description: You can call in a minor anomalous asset to assist once per day. The nature of the asset is determined by the GM based on the situation.

abilities.name: Anomalous Tactics
abilities.description: You're trained in all tasks related to strategic use of anomalous assets and understanding their capabilities.

abilities.name: Reality Bubble
abilities.description: You can create a small area of stabilized reality, protecting against minor reality fluctuations for 10 minutes.

abilities.name: Containment Breach Authorization
abilities.description: Once per day, you can authorize the controlled release of a contained anomaly to assist in an operation. This is highly risky and may have severe consequences.

abilities.name: Anomalous Synergy
abilities.description: You can attempt to combine the effects of two anomalous assets or phenomena. This is a difficult Intellect task and may have unpredictable results.

abilities.name: Reality Restructuring
abilities.description: You can attempt to temporarily alter local reality using a combination of anomalous assets. This is extremely difficult and potentially dangerous.

abilities.name: Omega-Level Asset Deployment
abilities.description: Once per session, you can deploy an Omega-level anomalous asset. This is incredibly powerful but comes with severe risks and consequences.
